messages:
maria: quick heads-up — link-scan flagged a cluster of 404s under /guides/runtime. can someone own a tiny sweep this sprint? :eyes:

link-scan-bot: automated report: 6 broken URLs found in /guides/runtime (images + anchor links). details: https://internal.tools/link-scan/1704123456

jamal: I can take the ownership for runtime guides this sprint. will triage the 6 and open PRs for rehosts/redirects. ping me if any are high-risk. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks @jamal. quick note — two of those are image 403s coming from the old CDN host, rehost to assets.redwood.internal should fix. pattern is `/cdn-old/.../screenshot*.png`

smita: fyi we have a canary deploy scheduled tmrw afternoon, so if any edits touch the runtime sidebar or frontmatter, pls flag for staging preview. small UX regressions will be caught there.

jamal: good call. plan: (1) triage list and mark severity (2) rehost images where needed + replace anchors for dead intra-doc links (3) open small PRs and request quick reviews. target: 3 PRs by EOD Thu.

kirby: if you need a quick grep for all affected files, run: ```bash
rg "cdn-old|/guides/runtime" docs/ -n --hidden
``` will show files. also `sed` one-liner ready for rehost if paths are predictable.

alex: one more — there's a runtime troubleshooting runbook that other teams link to externally. if that file's slug changes, we need redirects. mark any slug edits as "redirect needed" in PR description.

jamal: noted. will add `redirect: true` label in PR body when appropriate. also adding reviewers @maria @smita for the sidebar/frontmatter quick check.

maria: thanks. can you paste the 6 filenames here when you triage so we can prioritize customer-facing ones first?

jamal: doing triage now, paste initial list in 15m. quick question — do we prefer rehost vs shortlink redirect for CDN 403s? cost tradeoffs?

smita: prefer rehost to internal assets for docs images, unless the image is maintained by another product team. redirects add churn long-term.

jamal: got it. rehost where safe, redirect only for externally referenced canonical docs.

link-scan-bot: follow-up: next scheduled sweep in 7 days. consider adding owners metadata to these files to reduce noise.

maria: agreed — after PRs merge, let's add `owners: docs-runtime` frontmatter to the edited pages. small follow-up task for next sprint. :white_check_mark:

jamal: pasted triage list: 
- docs/guides/runtime/latency-tuning.md (image 403)
- docs/guides/runtime/caching.md (dead anchor: #kv-cache)
- docs/guides/runtime/deploy-checklist.md (two images 404)
- docs/guides/runtime/troubleshooting.md (slug referenced externally)
- docs/guides/runtime/quantization.md (broken internal link to /models/quantize)
- docs/guides/runtime/examples.md (one screenshot 403)

alex: prioritization: troubleshooting.md > latency-tuning.md > deploy-checklist.md > others. troubleshooting is customer-linked.

smita: I'll stand by to do quick frontmatter review once PRs show up.

maria: awesome. jamal, drop PR links here when ready and add `docs-sweep` label. I’ll nudge reviewers in the morning. :coffee:
